name: @danielsimonjr/mathts-functions
description: Mathematical functions for MathTS - arithmetic, algebra, trigonometry, statistics, and more
author: Daniel Simon Jr.

scripts.build: node scripts/gen-public-overloads.mjs && tsdown src/index.ts src/subpath-evaluate.ts src/scalar-batch-parallel.ts src/scalar-batch.worker.ts --format esm && tsc -p tsconfig.dts.json && node scripts/copy-public-types.mjs && node scripts/copy-wasm.mjs && node ../tools/ensure-js-sourcemaps.mjs
scripts.dev: tsdown src/index.ts src/subpath-evaluate.ts src/scalar-batch-parallel.ts src/scalar-batch.worker.ts --format esm --watch --on-success "tsc -p tsconfig.dts.json && node scripts/copy-public-types.mjs && node scripts/copy-wasm.mjs && node ../tools/ensure-js-sourcemaps.mjs"
scripts.test:diff: node tests/diff-special.test.mjs && node tests/diff-elementwise.test.mjs && node tests/diff-fusion.test.mjs
scripts.build:prod: node scripts/gen-public-overloads.mjs && tsdown src/index.ts src/subpath-evaluate.ts src/scalar-batch-parallel.ts src/scalar-batch.worker.ts --format esm --minify && tsc -p tsconfig.dts.json && node scripts/copy-public-types.mjs && node scripts/copy-wasm.mjs && node ../tools/ensure-js-sourcemaps.mjs
